selection_rule: For each split, sort local task directories lexicographically, retain only look_at_obj_in_light tasks, exclude every TG4 held-out and v4-result identity, and select the first 12 remaining tasks.

conditions.description: Use the current first-eligible admissible action rule exactly as exercised by v4.
Use historical_actions and observable-state fingerprints to penalize repeated recent action-state cycles while preserving admissibility.
Use only observation, historical_actions, and admissible_actions to prefer observable novelty and skill/edge changes after cycle detection; no task description or hidden goal is available.

stop_rule: stop on first hard invariant violation
paired_seed_rule: Use one fixed seed per development task and reuse that seed across all three conditions.

decision_gate.mechanism_positive: At least one trajectory ablation reduces two_cycle_rate by at least 50% relative to baseline, does not exceed 25% abstention, preserves 100% trace validity, and gains at least 2 paired successes over baseline.
decision_gate.observability_limited: Trajectory ablations reduce two_cycle_rate by at least 50% but neither reaches more than 1/24 successes, while the separate indistinguishable-goal audit finds an allowed-input equivalence class with conflicting task goals.
decision_gate.negative: Neither trajectory ablation reduces two_cycle_rate by at least 50%, or a trajectory ablation violates admissibility, trace, or input-isolation constraints.
decision_gate.inconclusive: The results do not satisfy any predeclared positive, observability-limited, or negative rule.

identifiability_audit.purpose: Check whether identical allowed-input histories can correspond to conflicting task goals without feeding goal metadata into any selector.
